poses.tablet: Skellywix taps a violet tablet. A white flower headband crowns her ice-blue bob, and pink hairpins frame her visible blue eye.
poses.delighted: Skellywix smiles and waves a white-gloved hand, with the other tucked against her cheek.
poses.treat: Skellywix lifts a crescent biscuit to her lips and holds the paper bag against her white apron.
poses.nap: Skellywix sits with her legs tucked to one side. Her blue eye is closed, and her cheek rests on her folded hands.

workflow.identify_file: File ID. Headers first, forum lore second.
workflow.compare_builds: A on one deck, B on the other. Spot the remix.
workflow.verify_checksum: Bring your own reference hash. No file gets to sign its own guestbook.

case.inspect: Header read. Size, format, fingerprint. Into the .NFO it goes.
case.match: Hashes match. Keep the source of that reference handy.
case.mismatch: Hash mismatch. Save the reference with your .NFO.
case.mixed: This one matches. The earlier mismatch still counts in this folio.
case.identical: Same hash on both decks. No difference showed up in this check.
case.different: Different builds. The side-by-side has the receipts.
case.critique: Second opinion just landed. Check the posts it cites, not the attitude.
case.export: Ledger copied. Take those receipts with you.
